GXL Paperclip ( https://paperclip.gxl.ai/chat/ ) is an AI tool that has an interesting search feature that allows you to search for papers using analogical searching to find papers from different domains of knowledge that use methods with a similar structure.  To do this, paste the following into your Paperclip prompt: paperclip search --ranking analogical "abstract"
"Abstract" is the abstract of a paper that uses the method of interest.
